texts:
We’re thrilled to unveil that CommBank has joined forces as the presenting partner for Vogue Codes 2024! Since its inception in 2016, Vogue Codes has been a powerhouse advocating for women in STEM across Australia. This year’s captivating theme, Technotopia: Designing the World of Tomorrow, will delve into the groundbreaking ideas and innovations shaping our future.

This partnership underscores our dedication to fostering gender diversity and inclusion within the tech sector. It’s an incredible platform to highlight the exceptional female technologists at CommBank, featuring them in panels, editorials, and digital content throughout the event series.

Mark your calendars for the main Summit at Carriageworks Sydney on June 22nd, where 700 attendees will gather to explore the cutting-edge landscape of technology. Additionally, we’re excited to introduce Vogue Codes Con, tailored for university students aspiring to tech careers.

Join us in spreading the excitement by sharing the LinkedIn tile and media release link. For those needing a head start, we’ve included some suggested copy to kick things off. Let’s make this a memorable year for innovation and inclusivity!
